title: Phase Transition of Eigenvalues of Covariances from the Spiked Mixture Model in High-dimensional Regimes
summary: The spiked mixture model (SMM) has been introduced as a probabilistic model that generalizes the single-spike (Wishart) model to a mixture model form. With applications ranging from imaging mass spectrometry in the life sciences to hyperspectral imaging in computer vision, it is crucial to understand under which circumstances its signals can be recovered from noisy measurements. The highly multiplexed nature of these measurement types furthermore necessitates such analysis to hold in highdimensional settings.
